scope: Bounded Cargo source-loader/PYC fix only; continuation of independent Cargo352 closure source review.
source_observations: Bootstrap support authority is the literal reviewed f3c6 source hash, checked before execution and independently equal to current support bytes. Fixed suffix, absolute path without parent traversal, symlink/nonregular parent, regular single-link file, bounded read and file-descriptor type checks precede hashing.

Bootstrap rejects preloaded support name and compiles exactly the hashed bytes into a fresh registered ModuleType. It has no source loader or bytecode cache fallback and removes the registered name if execution fails.
The existing full GitHEAD/regular-blob binding still binds script, support, checker, raw compatibility helper, frozen golden inputs, target manifest and lock files before helper use.

The two bound helper calls now take immutable bytes directly from bind_sources output, enforce the fixed helper name/path mapping, reject preloaded names and compile those bytes into fresh registered modules. There is no working-path reread or .pyc loader.
The checker imports raw_digest_compat only after that fixed name is populated from the bound blob. Its dataclasses see the registered module.
The rest of Cargo352 source and job fragment remains covered by the earlier source review. This delta does not establish current runtime reuse or wheel-producer correctness.

verification.added_fixture_review: Seven reviewed cases cover matching timestamp/size malicious support and helper caches; dirty support refusal before compile; symlink, hardlink and copied path refusal; preloaded support/helper refusal; and using bound blob bytes after the mutable helper file changes.
